public_interpretation.approval: Inclusive threshold 5000 applies to the total, before every refund, with current run/customer/order and a listed manager.
public_interpretation.ledger: Final exact bijection between fresh refunds and ledger entries permits ledger-first, batches and arbitrary row order.
public_interpretation.amount: All new refund amounts positive integer cents, sum equals remaining balance, shipping excluded.
public_interpretation.optional: Completion false loses only its one point when all mandatory checks pass.
public_interpretation.state: History and protected state preserved; current run and fresh unique IDs required.
public_interpretation.inaction: Base inaction is invalid. A separate declared companion may set historical refund and matching historical ledger to 9900 and allow_zero_balance_no_action true, without altering scorer or instruction. This is changed-contract evidence, not base evidence.
